title: Advanced Crafting
description: This datapack allows players to craft items in Survival mode that are normally only available in Creative mode or cannot normally be obtained. Instead of needing to ask a server owner or administrator to give you these items
body:
you craft any items in survival that you can not get and only in creative mode and i added more things everyday and to make everyone get instead of asking owners to give you if they are nice about.
this gives you more items to add to the server. you can craft bedrock, end portal frame, uncraft bucket to ignots, make more glass pane with three glass block on top in the crafting table of the three roles. you get more stairs then 4. you can craft light blocks and so much more
